title: Read, Look and Retell: Story Details
description: Read five short decodable stories and answer who, where, and what questions; put a story in order; name what a story teaches; and retell it in three parts.
learningFocus: Read a short story and answer questions about its key details, order its events, name what it teaches, and retell it in order.
adultGuidance: The stories are for reading, not just looking: your child reads the words and the pictures help. If stuck on a word, cover the vowel team or the silent e, read the rest, then add the long sound. Page 1 is Sam and the cat (Sam, in the sun, nap); Page 2 is Ben and the red bike (Ben, the hill, a red kite); Page 3 orders Mia's cake (eggs and milk, makes a big cake, eats the cake); Page 4 is Kim and the kite (it is kind to share); Page 5 is a day at the lake (Sam and Kim watch the duck swim, then eat and play).
